title: Case 06: Guided task — create a course (Vue 3)
titleZh: 案例06：引导任务创建课程（Vue 3）
summary: A realistic course page whose only job is creating a course. The assistant understands a whole description through task working memory, asks only for real gaps, points at page fields, and reads the saved record back.
summaryZh: 一个真实的课程页面，只做“创建课程”这件事。助手基于任务工作记忆理解整段描述，只追问真正的缺口、定位页面字段，并在保存后回读课程列表。

guide.title: One page, one job, one reusable guide
guide.titleZh: 一页一件事，一套可复用的引导
intro: A Pling integration needs three things: declare the task fields, give the task a thin guide, and write values back into the existing form while an existing action saves. The assistant reads task working memory; the page only handles explicit UI commands.

This example deliberately avoids a multi-module admin dashboard. The page is the original course form. The model understands the full sentence, calls narrow task tools, and leaves the final save to the person.
introZh: 接入本身只有三件事：声明任务字段、给任务一个很薄的 guide、把值写回现有表单并交给已有动作保存。助手读取任务工作记忆，页面只执行明确的界面命令。
这个示例刻意不混入多个后台模块。页面就是原来的创建课程表单；模型理解整段描述、调用少量窄工具，最终保存仍由人确认。

steps.title: Minimum: register a task and its fields
steps.titleZh: 最小接入：注册任务与字段
steps.body: The minimum is one TaskDefinition (id, title, fields, save step), a thin guide (one step, declared fields, and the save action), and one registration. route, scope, and autoStart only decide when the task is available.
steps.bodyZh: 最小接入是一个 TaskDefinition（id、title、fields、保存步骤）、一个很薄的 guide（一个步骤、声明字段、保存动作），再加一次注册。route、scope、autoStart 只决定任务何时可用。

steps.title: Add the goal and its boundaries
steps.body: objective, constraints, and successCriteria tell the assistant why the task exists, what it must not cross, and when it is genuinely done. A minimum integration can ship with fields only; these are the upgrades that make behaviour more reliable.
steps.bodyZh: objective、constraints、successCriteria 让助手理解为什么做、不能越过什么、何时算真正完成。最小接入可以只写 fields；这些是让行为更稳的增强项。

steps.title: Let the model use working memory
steps.titleZh: 让模型使用任务工作记忆
steps.body: The active task projects its objective, constraints, current values and gaps into the model context. A whole sentence can update several declared fields through pling_update_task; questions and corrections stay normal conversation.
steps.bodyZh: 当前任务会把目标、约束、现有值与缺口投影到模型上下文。整段描述可以通过 pling_update_task 一次更新多个已声明字段；提问与修正仍然是普通对话。

steps.title: Expose page-owned controls
steps.body: The guide names the review, confirmation and cancel commands that the model may invoke. These commands only move attention or open a read-only review; they never execute the business write.
steps.bodyZh: guide 声明模型可以调用的核对、确认与取消命令。这些命令只移动注意力或打开只读核对，不会执行业务写入。

steps.title: Customise what the user sees (optional)
steps.titleZh: 自定义用户看到什么（可省略）
steps.body: A full custom guide is optional. The minimum guide is one step, declared fields, and a save action; this demo adds explicit page commands and read-back evidence on top of that minimum.
steps.bodyZh: 完整定制 guide 是可选的。最小 guide 只有一个步骤、声明字段和保存动作；本示例在此基础上增加了显式页面命令和回读证据。

steps.title: Write into the original controls
steps.body: Command handlers update the existing draft or mark the real field on the form. The chat never grows a second copy of the form; the original page remains the source of truth.
steps.bodyZh: 命令处理函数更新现有草稿，或在表单上标记真实字段。聊天里不会再长出一套表单，原页面始终是事实来源。

steps.title: Verify from the page, not from the promise
steps.titleZh: 从页面验证，而不是相信返回值
steps.body: After create_course runs, the page checks that the new record is first in the catalogue. Completion is based on that read-back, not merely on an action result.
steps.bodyZh: create_course 执行后，页面确认新记录已经位于课程库第一位。完成态依据这次回读，而不是只相信动作返回值。

guide.note: A minimum integration can stop after one TaskDefinition, a thin guide, and one pling.task.define. This demo adds explicit model-callable guide commands and read-back verification; it contains no natural-language intent parser.
guide.noteZh: 最小接入可以只写一个 TaskDefinition、一个薄 guide 和一次 pling.task.define；本示例额外声明模型可调用的引导命令并回读验证，不包含自然语言意图解析器。
